description: This file defines the RunningShellTable class, which manages shell settings and URL matching logic for multi-tenant routing in OrchardCore.

classes.name: RunningShellTable
classes.description: A class that manages shell settings and URL matching for tenant routing.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a ShellSettings instance to the table, updating default and internal mappings.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a ShellSettings instance from the table based on its name.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Matches a host and path to a ShellSettings, with fallback options.

methods.name: TryMatchInternal
methods.description: Attempts to find a matching ShellSettings based on host and path segments.

methods.name: TryMatchStarMapping
methods.description: Attempts to match star (*) wildcard host mappings.

methods.name: GetHostAndPrefix
methods.description: Constructs a host and prefix string from host and path segments.

methods.name: GetAllHostsAndPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves all host and prefix combinations from ShellSettings.

methods.name: DefaultIsCatchAll
methods.description: Checks if the default shell is a catch-all (no specific host or prefix).
